IGUI_PFP_Stop_VehicleGone: A vehicle is no longer there.
IGUI_PFP_Stop_TooFarApart: The tank ports are too far apart.
IGUI_PFP_Stop_DifferentLevel: Both tank ports must be on the same level.
IGUI_PFP_Stop_SameVehicle: Source and target must be different vehicles.
IGUI_PFP_Stop_PlayerTooFar: You are standing too far from the source tank.
IGUI_PFP_Stop_PlayerInVehicle: You have to get out of the vehicle.
IGUI_PFP_Stop_PumpGone: The pump is no longer in your inventory.
IGUI_PFP_Err_NotAPump: That is not a fuel pump.
IGUI_PFP_Err_UnknownSchema: This pump was saved by a newer version of the mod and is locked.
IGUI_PFP_Err_Broken: The pump is broken and has to be repaired.
IGUI_PFP_Err_SlotOccupied: This slot already holds a battery.
IGUI_PFP_Err_NoRoom: No room in your inventory - the battery stays in the pump.
IGUI_PFP_Err_MissingParts: You need 2 scrap electronics and duct tape.
IGUI_PFP_Err_AlreadyPumping: You are already using a pump.
IGUI_PFP_Err_PumpInUse: This pump is already in use.
IGUI_PFP_Err_TankInUse: One of the tanks is already in use.
